STScreenTimeConfigurationObserver.doc: The object you use to observe changes to the current configuration.

STWebHistory.doc: The object you use to delete web-usage data.

STWebpageController.doc: The controller you use to report web usage and block restricted webpages.

-initWithUpdateQueue:.doc: Creates a configuration observer that reports updates on the queue you specify.

-startObserving.doc: Starts observing changes to the current configuration.

-stopObserving.doc: Stops observing changes to the current configuration.

-deleteAllHistory.doc: Deletes all web history associated with the bundle identifier you specified during initialization.

-deleteHistoryDuringInterval:.doc: Deletes web history that occurred during the date interval you specify.

-deleteHistoryForURL:.doc: Deletes all the web history for the URL you specify.

-fetchAllHistoryWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Fetches all web history associated with the bundle identifier and profile identifier you specified during initialization.

-fetchHistoryDuringInterval:completionHa.doc: Fetches web history that occurred during the date interval you specify.

-initWithBundleIdentifier:error:.doc: Creates a web history instance to delete web-usage data associated to the bundle identifier you specify.

-initWithBundleIdentifier:profileIdentif.doc: Creates a web history instance to delete web-usage data associated to the bundle identifier and profile identifier you specify.

-initWithProfileIdentifier:.doc: Creates a web history instance to delete web-usage data associated to the profile identifier you specify.

-setBundleIdentifier:error:.doc: Changes the bundle identifier used to report web usage.

enforcesChildRestrictions.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the device is currently enforcing child restrictions.

STWebHistoryProfileIdentifier.doc: An identifier representing a web history profile.

URLIsBlocked.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether a parent or guardian has blocked the URL.

URLIsPictureInPicture.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the webpage is currently displaying a floating picture in picture window.

URLIsPlayingVideo.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether there are one or more videos currently playing in the webpage.

profileIdentifier.doc: An optional identifier for the current browsing profile.

suppressUsageRecording.doc: A Boolean that indicates whether the webpage controller is not recording web usage.
